## Z-test для пропорций

Основной тест — `statsmodels.proportions_ztest`. Возвращает Z, p-value и нормальный CI для разности долей. Подходит когда метрика — конверсия (0/1) и обе группы достаточно большие, чтобы CLT работал.

from statsmodels.stats.proportion import proportions_ztest, confint_proportions_2indep

metric_col = '{{metric_column}}'
alpha = {{alpha}}

control = df[df['variant'] == 'control'][metric_col]
treatment = df[df['variant'] == 'treatment'][metric_col]

success = [treatment.sum(), control.sum()]
nobs = [len(treatment), len(control)]

z, p = proportions_ztest(success, nobs, alternative='two-sided')
ci_lo, ci_hi = confint_proportions_2indep(
    success[0], nobs[0], success[1], nobs[1],
    method='wald', alpha=alpha,
)
p_control = control.mean()
p_treatment = treatment.mean()
rel_lift = (p_treatment - p_control) / p_control if p_control else float('nan')

print(f'control CR  = {p_control:.4%}')
print(f'treatment CR = {p_treatment:.4%}')
print(f'absolute diff = {p_treatment - p_control:+.4%}')
print(f'relative lift = {rel_lift:+.2%}')
print(f'Z = {z:.4f}, p = {p:.4f}')
print(f'CI {1 - alpha:.0%}: [{ci_lo:+.4%}, {ci_hi:+.4%}]')
print('SIGNIFICANT' if p < alpha else 'not significant')

# Canonical bindings (Sprint 7 ADR-015) — читается export-cell.
p_value = float(p)
ci_lower = float(ci_lo)
ci_upper = float(ci_hi)
delta_rel = float(rel_lift) * 100
observed_diff = float(p_treatment - p_control)
control_mean = float(p_control)

# Точечный график эффекта: CI абсолютной разности vs 0 (Δrel в title).
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
if all(v is not None for v in (ci_lower, ci_upper, delta_rel, p_value)):
    center = observed_diff
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3))
    ax.errorbar([center], [0], xerr=[[center - ci_lower], [ci_upper - center]],
                fmt='o', color='#a3e635', ecolor='#a3e635', capsize=10, markersize=12)
    ax.axvline(0, color='#f87171', linestyle='--', linewidth=1, alpha=0.7, label='No effect')
    ax.set_yticks([])
    ax.set_xlabel('Absolute effect (treatment − control)')
    ax.set_title(f'Δrel = {delta_rel:+.2f}%   CI95 (абс. разность) [{ci_lower:+.4f}, {ci_upper:+.4f}]   p = {p_value:.4f}')
    ax.legend(loc='upper right', frameon=False)
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
